integrity: A complete reduction proof and standalone finite verifier are included; finite computational checks do not certify the infinite theorem, whose external matching theorem is cited.
scientific_limitations: The algorithm is a deterministic parameterized upper bound, not an optimality result. Polynomial capacitated exact-degree matching is imported from published theory; the bundled checker tests the reduction for finite words and does not implement that classical optimizer. The 2025 ordered-graph characterization may itself imply general FPT, while the explicit 3^r small-instance reduction is the asserted contribution.
title: Single-exponential shuffle-square recognition from compressed runs
